title: Opening and Frazier's birth date
summary: Russell opens the interview at Frazier's home, 14 December 1960; Frazier gives his birth date as 23 February 1904.

story.theme_name: Stating your name and birth date on tape
story.community_name: Opening the tape: name, birth date and birthplace

blocks.x: We start off by telling that this is an interview with Josiah Fraser. This is Bill Russell and Ralph Collins interviewing Mr. Fraser. And the place is 2014 Onzaga, your home. Yes, sir. And the date is December 14th, I believe, isn't it?
Now, can you tell us when you were born? Give me your full name, too, if you have a middle name.
I don't have no middle name, though. You ready? You ready yet? Yeah, go ahead. Go ahead. You mean it started when I was born? Yes. February 23rd, 1904.
